description: Two db-touching (server-escalated, §12.2 T1) functions that call each other — mutual recursion, terminated by an early `return` — compile clean. A cycle of calls is recursion, not a dependency-graph cycle (§31.2), and E-DG-001 is retired. Replaces the retired reactive/dg-001-cyclic-pos, which read the call cycle as an E-DG-001 `awaits` cycle. Both calls are statement-level, the shape impl#1's awaits-edge check fires on. Incidental W-PROGRAM-SPA-INFERRED / W-SQL-ROW-UNTYPED ignored by superset.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S479 batch items 1 and 2, PA recs adopted" item 2 — 'recursion between server functions is NOT E-DG-001'.
rationale: §31.2 (S479): 'A cycle of calls between functions — direct recursion, or mutual recursion such as two server functions that call each other (§13.4) — is recursion, not a dependency cycle. The compiler SHALL NOT reject it.' §13.4: 'A server-escalated function MAY call another server-escalated function.'
